# Version 4.157.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m157 engine update**

## Highlights

The upcoming SkiaSharp 4.157.0 updates the native engine to Skia m157 without changing the managed API surface. Generated LibraryImport bindings also gain explicit calling-convention metadata. Native Graphite Metal integrations must account for the updated iOS and tvOS runtime minimum. HarfBuzzSharp advances to package revision 14.4.0.200; the native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.4.0.

## Breaking Changes

- **Target iOS and tvOS 15 for Graphite Metal** — Native Graphite Metal now requires iOS or tvOS 15 or later; target those versions or newer when using that backend. Its macOS minimum remains 12. These native backend minimums do not replace higher managed or framework requirements. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Engine

- **Skia m157** — Updates the bundled Skia engine to milestone 157 while preserving the m156 glyph-bounds guard. Managed wrappers and public signatures are unchanged. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Bug Fixes

- **Explicit cdecl for generated imports** — LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching the existing DllImport and delegate paths. This addresses an ABI mismatch risk associated with reported Windows x86 stack growth; runtime validation of that symptom remains outstanding. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))
